title: Intermittent HTTP 503 errors on web storefront
description: Customers are intermittently seeing 'Service Unavailable' pages on the web storefront. The API gateway is returning HTTP 503 for roughly 1 in 6 requests to the product-catalog service, correlated with slow upstream response times and high JVM heap saturation.
